_comment: Verification class registry for TEST-PREP phase 8a-half (v3). Selection rule-ordered; first match wins. Playbook: .cursor/pipelines/test-prep.md. Profiles: docs/test-prep-draft-profiles.json.

config_posture.description: Instrument/account/group/routing posture before or without trade ladders.

draft_shape.actions: Expand every case_outline row: confirm configuration from precon; help/show or posture checks with session placeholders.
draft_shape.results: Posture matches coverage scenario_line and requirement intent.
draft_shape.peculiarities: Group names from exploration; instrument ids as placeholders.

stateful_ladder.description: Multi-step trade ladder; engine truth via console metrics (literary execution templates in prep).

draft_shape.actions: Expand every case_outline row using command_patterns.ladder_step with session placeholders; no whole-scenario [TBD].
draft_shape.results: Weighted-average opening-side rules, zero-cross, flat, partial close per requirement keys.
draft_shape.peculiarities: show position_metrics_from_publisher family; multiplier; account placeholders.

derived_metric.description: Recalculate Open P/L, % PL gross, or similar from observed fields.

draft_shape.actions: Expand case_outline: read metrics from console/UI; compare to formula in Peculiarities.
draft_shape.results: Metric matches formula within [tolerance:TBD] or [oracle:TBD] when blocked.
draft_shape.peculiarities: Full formulas; mark price rules; rounding policy; labels from 8a¾ metric_columns.

cross_surface_parity.description: Same metrics or labels across dxTrade5, WebBroker, Adaptive shells.

draft_shape.actions: Expand case_outline: capture metric labels per surface (8a¾); compare values within tolerance.
draft_shape.results: Parity or structured absence with ! reason when shell omits metric.

invariant_under_change.description: Configuration change must not rewrite existing position state (e.g. avg price).

draft_shape.actions: Expand case_outline: establish position; change group/config; re-read metric with placeholders.

rounding_matrix.description: Rounding policy matrix for average price and P/L display (CRTQA-10183-style).

draft_shape.actions: Expand case_outline: micro-ladders per rounding case; state expected rounded values as [oracle:TBD] when needed.
draft_shape.results: Rounded average and P/L match policy per case row.
draft_shape.peculiarities: dp rules, floor rules, currency context.
Pointers to coverage detail_lines and discover gaps.

journey_smoke.description: End-user journey or UI flow without calculation contract.

doc_or_pr_only.description: Proof via PR, doc, or analysis only—no runtime ladder in prep.

draft_shape.actions: [REQUIRES: source] or review checklist pointer only.
draft_shape.peculiarities: Links to requirement keys in results only.

selection_rules.when: discover evidence_need includes pr only and no ui console sql on primary chk
scenario_line mentions rounding or decimal places or 7 dp or floor rule for P/L
coverage section contains Cash settlement or scenario_line mentions settlement
scenario_line mentions group change or does not affect existing or invariant
calculation_contract is ladder_present or scenario_line mentions ladder or weighted-average ladder
scenario_line mentions Open P/L or % PL or recalculate or formula
surfaces includes dxtrade5 or webbroker or adaptive and scenario_line mentions parity or matching or same three metrics
section contains configuration or instrument posture or WeightedAvg configuration

_selection_note: Agent applies rules in priority order using coverage check row + optional discover obligation row; document choice in verification_plan[].selection_rule_priority.
